map.description: Diagram JSON this sidecar owns, as a POSIX path relative to the directory holding this file.

parent.description: Drilldown link. Declares this diagram as the child of one component in another map; every glob below must be a syntactic subset of that component's globs.

excluded.description: Repository paths that no component owns (generated output, lockfiles, packaged artifacts). Applied before component matching. Declared presets run after both and also produce excluded.

presets.description: Named noise classes. A path that matches a declared preset and is not already touched, ambiguous, or explicitly excluded is classified excluded with matchedGlob preset:<name>. Undeclared presets do nothing. Glob lists live in OWNERSHIP_PRESETS (ownership.mjs) and are locked to locatorVersion 2.

components.description: One entry per component id in the referenced map. An empty globs list declares a component that owns no repository path.

child_map.description: Child diagram that expands this component. Its sidecar must declare a matching parent link.

glob.description: POSIX path glob relative to the Git top-level. Segments are separated by '/'; a segment is either '**' (zero or more segments) or a pattern segment using '*' (no '/'), '?' (one character, no '/'), and '{a,b}' literal alternatives.
